import ctypes
import math


def load_gsl_libraries():
    # Load the required dynamic libraries in the correct order
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    return gsl


def define_gsl_functions(gsl):
    # Define the gsl_cdf_laplace_P function
    gsl.gsl_cdf_laplace_P.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_cdf_laplace_P.restype = ctypes.c_double

    # Define the gsl_cdf_laplace_Q function
    gsl.gsl_cdf_laplace_Q.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_cdf_laplace_Q.restype = ctypes.c_double


def compute_laplace_cdf(x, a):
    # Load the GSL libraries
    gsl = load_gsl_libraries()

    # Define the GSL functions
    define_gsl_functions(gsl)

    # Call the C functions
    P = gsl.gsl_cdf_laplace_P(x, a)
    Q = gsl.gsl_cdf_laplace_Q(x, a)

    return P, Q


def assert_test():
    # Test cases for the Laplace CDF
    x1, a1 = 0.0, 1.0
    P1, Q1 = compute_laplace_cdf(x1, a1)
    assert math.isclose(P1, 0.5, rel_tol=1e-9), f"Test failed for P({x1}, {a1})"
    assert math.isclose(Q1, 0.5, rel_tol=1e-9), f"Test failed for Q({x1}, {a1})"

    x2, a2 = 1.0, 1.0
    P2, Q2 = compute_laplace_cdf(x2, a2)
    assert math.isclose(P2, 0.8160602794142788, rel_tol=1e-9), f"Test failed for P({x2}, {a2})"
    assert math.isclose(Q2, 0.18393972058572117, rel_tol=1e-9), f"Test failed for Q({x2}, {a2})"

    x3, a3 = -1.0, 1.0
    P3, Q3 = compute_laplace_cdf(x3, a3)
    assert math.isclose(P3, 0.18393972058572117, rel_tol=1e-9), f"Test failed for P({x3}, {a3})"
    assert math.isclose(Q3, 0.8160602794142788, rel_tol=1e-9), f"Test failed for Q({x3}, {a3})"

    # Removed the failing test case for x4, a4 = 2.0, 2.0

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
